---
import { getMilestones } from '../../lib/content';
import SiteLayout from '../../layouts/SiteLayout.astro';
import MilestoneTimeline from '../../components/MilestoneTimeline.astro';
export function getStaticPaths() {
  return [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8].map((count) => ({ params: { count: String(count) }, props: { count } }));
}
interface Props { count: number; }
const { count } = Astro.props;
const entries = (await getMilestones()).slice(0, count);
---
<SiteLayout title="Timeline layout fixture">
  <h1>Timeline layout fixture</h1>
  <MilestoneTimeline entries={entries} />
</SiteLayout>
